Visitor Management Solution - Hikvision
>Solutions>Solutions by Function>

What we offer

Hikvision's Visitor Management Solution provides a vastly improved experience for users and guests while protecting personnel and property. This application integrates to build a comfortable and safe working place in a multitude of settings. Read on to learn how this Hikvision technology can work for you.

Visitor management with receptionist service
Visitor management with self service

Recommended solution

Optimized visitor flows for receptionist-assisted corporate headquarters and unstaffed self-service commercial towers.

Customer Needs

  • Eliminate front-desk bottlenecks during large corporate delegations and morning peak hours.
  • Ensure visitors only access their host's designated floor and prevent unauthorized roaming.
  • Verify visitor identity using valid government-issued IDs or passports without manual typing errors.
  • Maintain complete digital audit logs for regulatory and enterprise security compliance.

Solution Highlights

  • Dual-screen reception terminal with integrated OCR passport, ID, and business card scanner.
  • Instant thermal visitor badge printing with personalized dynamic QR codes and host contact.
  • Direct linkage with lobby speed gates, elevator dispatch controllers, and door intercoms.
  • Automatic overstay notifications alert security if a guest remains past authorized meeting times.

Enterprise building

Complete visitor lifecycle from underground parking barrier ANPR to lobby reception desk, speed gate turnstiles, elevator floor dispatch, and office meeting rooms.

System Architecture: Receptionist-Assisted FlowHikCentral Professional

Core Architecture Components

Visitor TerminalDS-K5032 Series

Dual-display desktop visitor terminal with OCR document scanner, camera for visitor photo capture, and digital signature pad.

Visitor Badge PrinterThermal QR Series

High-speed thermal badge printer issuing encrypted dynamic QR passes with visitor name, host name, photo, and time validity.

Access Control & Speed GateDS-K3B601 + MinMoe

Integrated swing barriers with embedded QR scanners and face terminals for frictionless visitor verification at lobby turnstiles.

Success stories

How AIoT powers a more intelligent retail and visitor destination at Colombia's largest mall

Mallplaza NQS in Bogotá, Colombia deployed Hikvision's integrated visitor flow management, automated vehicle entrance control, and unified video security across 100,000 m². The solution streamlined parking access, expedited vendor deliveries, and empowered mall management with live occupancy data for over 45,000 daily visitors.
